Thanks Aisha — copying the core team. Quick thoughts:

- Sequencing: Id prefer coding first (longest, warms candidate up) -> pairing -> systems -> manager. Pairing right after coding gives us a short practical follow-up and keeps the candidates flow.
- Timing: Move a 10-min buffer between slots (gives quiet-window and scribe a chance to jot notes). So the practical agenda becomes 12:00-12:45 / 12:55-13:15 pairing / 13:25-13:55 systems / 14:05-14:35 manager.
- Debrief owner: Laura — would you be willing to own the scorecard and run the 15-min async debrief after the loop? If Laura is OOO, Priyom can take it.
- Standby lane: Please nominate a backup interviewer for coding in case of last-minute conflicts (Kimberly as fallback). Also confirm that we have a sandbox link for the pairing exercise (browser-based).

Action items:
1) Laura: confirm debrief ownership and interviewer roster
2) Priyom: create calendar blocks and share Zoom + pairing link
3) Kimberly: be standby for coding (12:00 slot)
